content: Jesusta cäsucushaga Diosga manam cunchuchimäshunchu
Chaymi noganchiga nä Jesuspita shumag mayacurayarga imanaypanuysi cäsucuyar cawashun mana pantacashanuy puriyänanchipag.
Sinaí jircachru angelcunaga cay nipäcuram: “Mana cäsucugcunataga Diosga cunchuchingam”. Nätan nipäcungannuylam Diosga cunchuchira.

Chaynuymi noganchitas cunchuchimäshun salvacug rimangan chay alisca ali willapata mana cäsucushaga. Chay willapataga Jesús quiquinmi naupataga musyachira, nätan Diospita mayacugcunas chay willapatam nimaranchi.
Chaura mayacugcunas, jinaman Diossi chay willapa razoncag canganta musyachipäcura Santu Espiritupa munayninwan ima-aygatas ruraypam. Chaynuy rurapäcura Santu Espíritu munangannuylam.
Jesusga runaman muyusha salvamänanchi raygom
Chaura Diosga manam angelcunatachu “Mushogman cay pachata muyuchiptï, gammi chaychru mandanqui” nira.
Antis isquirbishachrüga cay niyanmi:

content.text: jinaman jana pachapita shamusha runata cuidayanqui?
Nätan gamga chay runata nirayanqui nachrga nachrga angelcunanuy cananpagmi”.
Chaymi lapan ima-aygatas munayninman chruraruray mandananpag” niyanmi.

content: Chauraga manam imalas catushachu, nätan chay mandayangantaga manam shumag ricapunchiragchu.

Chaura cay niyangäcunataga niyä Jesuspitam. Payga manam alä unaychu angelcunapita mas manacagpag ricasha cara. Manacagpag ricasha cara lapanchita cuyapämarlanchi cunchuyar cruzchru wanurmi. Nätan cananga alisca alinninpag ricasham cayan.
Chaynuy Jesuswan ruracara ima-aygatas Camag Dios pinsiangannuylam. Chaynuy wanunganpam cananga achca runacuna paywan cawapäcunga. Chaymi canan Jesusga cayan salvacugninchi.
Chaura Jesusmi noganchitaga raquirayämanchi Diospa runan cananchipag. Chaymi cananga cayan Tayta Diosga taytanchi Jesuspas, jinaman noganchipas. Chaymi Jesusga mana pengacular “Ayllücuna” niyämanchi.
Chaynuymi isquirbishachru cay niyan:
Chaypitas cay niyantan:
Niratan:
Chaura Jesusga noganchinuysi runamanmi muyusha. Chaymi wanuras, jinaman chay wanunganpam juchäcachimagninchi Asyagtas yalira.
Chaynuypam Asyagpa munayninchru, Diospita raquicasha cayasha jorgamasha canchi.
Musyanganchinuysi Jesusga manam aywamura angelcuna yanapagchu, antis aywamura noganchi Abrahampa castancunata yanapämagninchim.

Chaymi Jesusga noganchinuy runaman muyura. Chaynuypam payga cara Diospa sacerdötin, alisca cuyapacug, jinaman Dios ningannuy cawag. Chaura Jesusga lapan runacunapa juchanpita wanura, Dios mana piñasha cananpagmi.
Payga noganchinuy runa carmi juchäcachiy munashas cara, nätan manam juchäcushachüga. Chaymi yanapämanchi paynuysi mana juchaman ishquinanchipag.
